name: A_FETCH_URLSCAN
description: Submit a URL for scanning via urlscan.io. Input: url. Stub-safe: when URLSCAN_API_KEY is unset, prints intent and returns a canned malicious verdict (score 85) so demo flows run offline. The real path submits the scan and returns the submission's report/screenshot URLs honestly (verdict: submitted, score 0 — the scan is async).
